title: The Bell of the Damned
description: A colossal bearded giant emerges from a dark gothic castle, gripping a massive ornate bell with one hand while pulling a chain with the other. In the foreground, a horned king in a black and white patterned robe stands beside a large black bull, leading a procession of hooded figures and white spectral wolves through a misty courtyard lined with glowing lanterns.
prompt: A towering bearded giant rises from a dark gothic castle on a rocky mountain, holding a huge ornate metal bell with symbols in one hand and pulling its chain with the other. In the foreground, a regal horned figure wearing a black and white patterned robe and crown stands beside a large black bull. They lead a procession of hooded figures and glowing white spectral wolves through a misty courtyard filled with lanterns under a dark, dramatic sky.
